title: Certify arrays over uninterpreted sorts (QF_AX) in Lean via clause log
summary: Inputs with arrays whose index and element sorts are uninterpreted (QF_AX) can now be certified in Lean through the clause log, with select, store and the extensionality witness defined and proved inside each generated file. 23 of z3test's 25 QF_AX benchmarks now verify, where none did before.
